name: 50Y-O-61
source:
[i]"I have long awaited the day of our meeting."[/i]

[i]Consecrated Android[/i]

Noah's lone android. The heroine gives him the name “Soyogi" based on his model number, 50Y-O-61. He's a mystical being, shrouded entirely in mystery.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/recordnoah/english/characters/?page=soyogi]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
